snippet.description:
What happens when you finally stop and look at what’s going on inside your mind?

At Winning The Mind Game, students explored their thoughts, emotional triggers, recurring patterns and the pressure that often comes with UPSC preparation.

Some spoke about gaining clarity around their emotions. Others realised they weren’t the only ones feeling this way. Many walked away with a different perspective on how they handle the journey.

Here’s what participants had to say after the workshop.

Missed the offline session? You can still join us online in September.

This September, join us for a set of workshops designed to help you build consistency, confidence, emotional resilience, and a stronger mindset throughout your UPSC journey.

🎬 13 September | 5:30–7:30 PM
Movie Screening
📍 Ganga Hall, LevelUp IAS

🧠 20 September | 10:00 AM–1:00 PM
Winning The Mind Game | Part 1
💻 Online Workshop

🧠 27 September | 10:00 AM–1:00 PM
Winning The Mind Game | Part 2
💻 Online Workshop

All sessions will be conducted by Sonali Ma'am (UPSC Mindset Coach, LevelUp IAS).
